text:
tori_cs: FYI QuasarOps renewal in ~4w. Noticed daily inference calls down ~82% over the last 14 days; their platform lead moved teams yesterday.
diag-bot: [ALERT] QuasarOps - Usage -82% (14d), Active seats: 7/60, Health score: 27/100. Link: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/quasarops/health
ben_csm: any infra signals or errors?
samir_se: saw recurring 504 spikes during batch windows aligned with timeout events; filed INF-99921 and attached traces.
kiara_ae: Sales heard QuasarOps requested a demo from AstraGrid and asked for a cost/latency comparison last week.
tori_cs: quick summary: champion move + infra tail issues + competitor probe = at-risk. Proposed play: 1) 15-min technical health call with interim owner 2) offer a 5-day no-cost perf bench on their dataset 3) canary INF-99921 patch and share before/after p99 graphs 4) provide 30 days of discounted capacity to keep traffic live
pricing_ops: approvals for credits up to $3k are fast-track with CS rationale.
ben_csm: outreach draft: "We noticed lower activity and want to run a short, no-cost benchmark on your dataset and share a side-by-side report. 15 min this week?" Thoughts?
kiara_ae: add: "If cost is the driver we'll include per-query TCO for your typical mix." Also ask what AstraGrid demo focused on.
samir_se: quick diagnostic I ran: ```SELECT count(*) FROM api_calls WHERE account='quasarops' AND ts > now()-interval '14 days'; -- 29 (prev 160)```
tori_cs: owners: @ben_csm outreach + exec slide; @samir_se infra fix + bench; @kiara_ae competitor intel; @tori_cs lead renewal ask.
ben_csm: pinging the customer now and will paste their reply here. :thumbsup:
